observations.claim: normalize_macos_authority completes with strict caps: at most 8 application names (each <=160 chars, deduplicated) and at most 8 bundle_ids matching [A-Za-z0-9_.-]+ (<=160 chars); actions=True with neither applications nor bundle_ids raises ValueError('macos actions require at least one exact application or bundle scope').

The macOS authority lease is bounded: lease_ttl_s must be numeric and is clamped to [1.0, 120.0] seconds with default 30.0; the emitted record carries schema 'hawking.goal.macos_authority.v1', goal_id from workunit_id_for_goal, observe/actions, applications, bundle_ids, lease_ttl_s, preemptible:True, and semantic_actions limited to ['AXPress'] only when actions are granted — confirming the docstring claim that there is no generic keyboard/mouse/shell escape hatch.

create_goal is the Goal admission entry point with an extensive keyword contract: defaults include authority_boundary='staging worktree only; no production mutation', flash_resource_rule='Flash protected-lane; native resident only; no unqualified provider fallback', completion_contract='RUNNING to COMPLETE only when acceptance met; emit canonical result', resident='KIMI_P0_OPERATIONAL', goal_mode='discrete_goal', worker_policy='auto', auto_scope='cloud', source='h_web', plus optional attachments, browser_authority, macos_authority, cognition_plan, parent_goal_ids, required_capabilities, external_roots, and budget fields.

create_goal begins validation: objective is required (ValueError if blank), goal_mode must be exactly 'discrete_goal' or 'worker_research', and worker_policy normalization begins (body cut at the window boundary, line 340).
observations.evidence: Lines ~335-340; content ends mid-validation at the requested window boundary (truncated:false, window-limited).
